# 📘 Assignment: Assignment Markdown Structure Guidelines

## 🎯 Objective

Learn how to create clear, consistent assignment pages that follow the repository template and help students understand the required work without confusion.

## 📝 Tasks

### 🛠️ Follow the standard template

#### Description
Create the assignment as a `README.md` file and keep the same structure used across the project.

#### Requirements
Completed assignment should:

- Match the template in [`templates/assignment-template.md`](../../templates/assignment-template.md)
- Use the required title format: `# 📘 Assignment: [Assignment Title]`
- Include the required sections: `## 🎯 Objective` and `## 📝 Tasks`
- Do not remove or skip any required sections from the template

### 🛠️ Write clear task instructions

#### Description
Define each task with a specific title and explain what students are expected to build or complete.

#### Requirements
Completed assignment should:

- Use task names that are action-oriented and easy to understand
- Add a short `Description` for each task
- Use a `Requirements` section with measurable bullet points
- Explain expected program behavior or output clearly enough for students to implement it

### 🛠️ Keep content student-friendly and consistent

#### Description
Make sure the assignment reads cleanly, uses the project’s icon conventions, and stays focused on learning outcomes.

#### Requirements
Completed assignment should:

- Use the exact icon style shown in the template
- Replace `[Assignment Title]` with a short, descriptive name
- Write a concise objective in 1-2 sentences
- Avoid extra sections unless they are explicitly required by the assignment
- Keep the language clear, encouraging, and aligned with the educational goals of the project
